# Curaprox USA

> Premium Swiss oral care brand offering innovative toothbrushes, electric brushes, and interdental cleaning solutions with proprietary CUREN® filament technology.

Curaprox specializes in gentle yet effective oral hygiene products designed for all ages, from babies to adults with sensitive gums. The brand combines Swiss engineering with advanced technologies like Hydrosonic electric brushes and specialized interdental brushes for comprehensive dental health.

- Curaprox
